verdict.rationale: Zulip lets you control where data lives by self-hosting the same software on a system of your choice. Its export/import tools also let you move data between Zulip Cloud and your own servers. However, nothing in the evidence shows a region or residency selector for the hosted Zulip Cloud service, so residency choice comes only from running your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: Zulip Cloud region/residency selection, documented data-location guarantees for the hosted service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: install a self-hosted Zulip server on a system of your choice
When you self-host Zulip, you get the same software as our Zulip Cloud customers.
You can move freely between Zulip Cloud hosting and your own servers with our high quality export and import tools.
